assets.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. High-fidelity production-design reference sheet for ONE original medieval mobile strategy game asset or coherent kit. Use the supplied village image ONLY as a visual style reference. Match its premium stylized 3D craftsmanship, terracotta tiled roofs, substantial carved stone and timber, teal cloth with restrained brass/gold details, warm light, charming human proportions and readable silhouettes. Create a new isolated reference sheet, NOT another village screenshot. Plain warm ivory studio background, subtle neutral ground shadows, crisp rendering, consistent scale and camera, generous separation between views, professional polished game art. Landscape 3:2 at the highest available useful resolution. Restrained tiny serif labels in dark teal, exact Portuguese title. No phone, no HUD, no commercial branding, no gems, no watermark. Do not introduce magic, fantasy monsters, modern machinery or modern construction gear. These are concept reference views, not a claim to be a functioning 3D model or animation atlas.

Layout: a large beautiful three-quarter isometric view of the completed building on the left, taking about 55 percent of the sheet. On the right, two smaller supporting views from front and rear/side, showing the SAME building and coherent roofs, doors, windows and materials. Along the bottom, three small consistent building-state sketches: foundation with materials, timber scaffolding during construction, modestly damaged finished building. Include one tiny generic standing worker silhouette near the main view for scale. Keep all views of the same object recognizable, not variants of unrelated buildings. Show a clear accessible entrance and a small delivery area. Identify the building by its activity and tools, not excessive text. Only enough ground to support the building, no surrounding village or large landscape. Moving machinery and important external equipment must be recognizable and geometrically plausible. Prefer tasteful medium-detail stylized modeling over photorealistic microtexture. Exact labels: main title below, plus short labels "Vista principal", "Frente", "Lateral / fundos", "Fundação", "Em construção", "Danificada".

Exact title: "Fazenda de cereais".
Asset identity: bld_13_fazenda_de_cereais.
Required subject and functional details: Celeiro e campos anexos. Semeia, cultiva e colhe trigo; área maior exige mais trabalho e transporte.
Building worker role: Agricultor.
Targeted correction: This asset is ONLY a CEREAL FARM: a broad low barn, threshing yard and modular golden wheat fields, clearly distinct from the separate windmill building. Absolutely NO windmills, NO sails, NO waterwheels, NO grinding mills or milling machinery. Farming and harvesting only. Show sheaves of wheat, sickles, a fork and grain sacks. Preserve all layout, materials, lighting and state-view requirements.
